text:
Alex Kim: FYI CI perf alert for master rolled in ~03:12 UTC. P95 for small-batch generation jumped ~20% after yesterday's merge. Seen on gpu-prod-4 and gpu-staging. :eyes:
Maria Lopez: looking now. initial profiling shows extra kernel fallback and ~30% more KV cache misses for short-seqlen jobs. I started a local bisect.
Chris Huang: rough suspect is the kernel selector heuristic change (commit abc1234) that added aggressive "prefer-stable-kernel" for seq < 128. It looks like it forces a slower matmul path in some cases.
Maria Lopez: git bisect gave this range: good: f9d21b5, bad: abc1234. Quick commands I ran: 
```
git checkout master
git bisect start
git bisect bad abc1234
git bisect good f9d21b5
# then ran perf harness on each step
```
Log snippet: 
```
[perf] model=llama-13b batch=1 seq=64 p95=84ms (baseline 70ms)
[kv] hit_rate=0.64 (baseline 0.91)
[kernel] selected=matmul_stable fallback=TRUE
```
Dana Patel: the new eviction tuning also changed prefetch window in kv cache (commit bcd5678) — could be amplifying misses when kernel switches change timing. So two commits may interact.
Lee Zhao: can we isolate? If kernel selector change alone causes latency without kv change then revert it. If both together, we need a hotfix that tweaks selector thresholds and reverts eviction window back for the release branch.
ci-bot: Automated perf alert: compare_artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/1973456789/compare (p95 +19%, p99 +12%, token cost unchanged)
Alex Kim: Proposal: fast path = cherry-pick a targeted fix to kernel selector (reduce aggressiveness) into release-candidate branch, run perf-suite in staging, if green then backport eviction tunings with a follow-up. Steps: 1) cherry-pick fix into release branch 1.12.x 2) force staging perf run 3) cut hotfix release if passes 4) schedule coordinated backport for eviction if still needed.
Chris Huang: I can prepare the cherry-pick with a minimal change: in runtime/kernel_selector.cc change threshold from 0.75 -> 0.55 and add a debug metric. Patch gist: https://gist.internal/patch/chrish/selector-fix
Maria Lopez: I'll run perf harness after the cherry-pick. Command I'm using: 
```
./scripts/perf/run.sh --model llama-13b --device gpu-4 --batch 1 --seq 64 --iters 120 --collect-kv
```
Dana Patel: added note: when verifying, check KV hit_rate and latency tail together. If hit rate drops back to ~0.9 and p95 aligns with baseline, good. Also validate streaming scenarios.
Lee Zhao: I'll create the release branch backport ticket and add QA checks. I'll also add a canary rollout plan: 10% traffic for 2h then 50% if stable.
Alex Kim: Assignments: Chris -> cherry-pick + PR, Maria -> perf runs + artifacts, Dana -> KV metrics validation, Lee -> release + rollout. Estimated timeline: cherry-pick + staging perf in next 2 hours, cut hotfix in ~4 hours if green.
Chris Huang: started the cherry-pick, opened PR #4227 against release/1.12.x. Short description: "reduce kernel selector aggressiveness for short sequences to avoid slower fallback". CI is queued.
Maria Lopez: perf run started. I pushed artifacts here: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/1973456789/staging. Early results: p95 down to +3% vs baseline, kv hit_rate=0.88. I'll let it run full 120 iters.
Alex Kim: Good signal. If final artifacts are within 5% p95 and kv hit_rate >= 0.85 we can proceed. Also add smoke tests for burst workloads.
Dana Patel: Quick note on verification checklist to add to PR description: 
- run perf harness (link)
- confirm kv hit_rate >= 0.85
- run e2e session streaming smoke
- validate no increased memory regression
- snapshot ci flamegraphs for both kernels
Lee Zhao: I'll hold the release cut until Maria posts final numbers and we get at least one successful canary perf baseline.
ci-bot: CI status for PR #4227: checks queued -> perf-suite running -> (ETA ~35m).
Maria Lopez: final numbers: p95 +2.1% (baseline 70ms -> 71.5ms), kv hit_rate 0.90, token throughput within noise. Smoke tests passed. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/1973456789/final.
Alex Kim: :shipit: Merge the cherry-pick to release/1.12.x, tag hotfix-1.12.1, and start canary rollout. Chris please include the verification checklist in the merge commit.
Chris Huang: Merged and tagged hotfix-1.12.1. Deployment started with canary=10%.
Lee Zhao: Monitoring: rolling out, observing traces. If we see any p95 spike >8% we rollback automatically.
Alex Kim: Great coordination — after canary window I'll open a follow-up to evaluate the eviction tuning interaction and plan a careful backport if necessary. Thanks everyone. :tada:
